name: Teth Golem Mountain
title: Teth Golem Mountain
summary: A barren-rock mesa south of Fort Tethana whose flat top (z 144) holds a ring of seven rock cave mouths (0x010011A9 huts, the golem caves; acpedia: each cave holds something special) and a wooden archway. The mesa drops to rocky lowlands at z 80-100.

landmarks.name: Cave mouths
landmarks.note: Seven rock huts from x 7188 to 7236 and y 22188 to 22260.

site.name: Teth Golem Mountain
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the mesa at (7212,22230), ground 151, 19 m from the cave huts.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (fort-tethana -> ayan-baqur).

shots.standingOrder: Fly east 32 m over the flat mesa top and its ring of rock cave mouths, the gimbal tracking them down through nadir; hold height and speed, at least 18 m above the rock.
shots.notes: Pass-over: the drone flies east 60 m at 6 m/s, 32 m above the flat top of the mesa (z 144). The gimbal tracks the ring of seven rock cave mouths (the golem caves) down through nadir and round, then a wooden archway and the drop to the rocky lowlands. The sun is behind the lens. Rank 3.
